method: Per-boot median of three samples (one for object-cold-64), normalized by guest frequency and iteration count; median of seven boots. Pair ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals. No empty-loop subtraction.
limitations: Receipts attest executable/Complex hashes; their remote bytes are not locally rehashed. Full HDD backing content/config bytes are not exported: invariant backing path/length/mtime, memory and EEPROM hash are verified. Runner creates a fresh overlay per run.
